# Loft conversion: schedule (target finish: Monday 30 June)

- Scaffold goes up Monday 12 May. The hire is paid to Friday 20 June, then costs £85 a week more.
- Roof window: ordered 1 April, with a lead time of "6 to 8 weeks". The roofer has a gap from Monday 19 May to Friday 23 May only; his next gap is mid-July.
- Steel beam: the engineer's drawings are with building control, who say "within 15 working days" from 28 April.
- Staircase: ordered 1 April. It is made to measure after the opening is cut, and takes 4 weeks after that.
- Electrics first fix Wednesday 4 June, then plastering from Monday 9 June. The plasterer needs 5 working days.
- Building control inspect before the boarding goes up. They need 10 working days' notice.
